column1: # What the taxonomy columns hold, by clade. The nine columns of taxonomy.tsv
# are PR2's nine positional levels (domain, supergroup, division,
# subdivision, class, order, family, genus, species), not Linnaean ranks: in
# animals and most fungi `class` holds the phylum, `order` a class or
# subphylum, `family` an order, class or subclass. A pipeline summarising
# "reads named to family or better", or applying a family-level identity
# floor, should read a call's depth through this table. Genus and species
# mean what they say throughout. Read off the release (v0.7.0); where a
# column mixes ranks, all are given, commonest first. "placeholder": PR2's
# Name_X / Name_XX, no information at that level. Clades not listed: the
# columns are close to their names (Apicomplexa, ciliates, diatoms ...).
